name: Redvale Landfill (Auckland)
notes: Operating regional landfill taking about half of Auckland's waste. Operator reports about 95% of methane captured and used for power (about 9 MW of engines), so the project case is incremental only. Consented to 2028; the 2036 end year assumes the proposed 7-8 year extension. Tonnage is a flat 600,000 t/yr (operator range 600,000-800,000), which ignores the early ramp-up. k and L0 are NZ ETS default-composition values, not site measurements.
sources: NZ Herald, Redvale extension (opening 1993, ~600,000 t/yr, 95% capture, closure 2028 extended to 2036): https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/landfill-proposal-aucklands-biggest-landfill-set-to-stay-open-for-seven-to-eight-years-longer-than-expected-after-delays-for-new-facility/KPBOPWAYUFAKTAEYY553PFXZGQ/

k and L0: waste-weighted from NZ ETS Schedule 3 default composition, as reproduced in MfE Landfill Gas Capture Management final report: https://environment.govt.nz/assets/publications/Waste/landfill-gas-management-final-report-.pdf

name: Kate Valley Landfill (Canterbury)
notes: Operating regional landfill serving Canterbury, opened 2005, expected to run to about 2040. Operator reports about 96% of methane captured, with 4.3 MW of gas engines commissioned in 2014, so the project case is incremental only. Tonnage is a flat 350,000 t/yr (actual 321,000 t in 2018/19 and 332,000 t in 2019/20). k and L0 are NZ ETS default-composition values, not site measurements.
sources: Transwaste Canterbury, Kate Valley (350,000 t/yr, 2005 opening, four 1 MW generators): https://transwastecanterbury.co.nz/kate-valley/
Transwaste Canterbury 2020 annual report (321,000 t in 2018/19, 332,000 t in 2019/20): https://transwastecanterbury.co.nz/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/TCL-2020-Annual-Report-FINAL-240920_signed.pdf

North Canterbury News, 8 Aug 2024 (about 96% of methane captured and destroyed): https://digital.ncnews.co.nz/html5/shared/ShowArticle.aspx?doc=HUR%2F2024%2F08%2F08&entity=Ar01501&sk=36CE9F3D&mode=text
Wikipedia, Kate Valley Landfill (coordinates 43°05'59"S 172°50'11"E, expected closure circa 2040, 4.3 MW commissioned 2014): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kate_Valley_Landfill

k and L0: waste-weighted from NZ ETS Schedule 3 default composition, as reproduced in MfE Landfill Gas Capture Management final report: https://environment.govt.nz/assets/publications/Waste/landfill-gas-management-final-report-.pdf
